snippet.title: Valleyball - How To Play A Brand New Sport
snippet.description:
Score through the ring. Flip the court. Do it again. This is everything you need to play Valleyball Versus, the physics sport where every limb is live and the ball never goes out.

Play free: https://ValleyballVS.com
Inaugural Championship: December 27, 2026

Valleyball Versus is a 1v1 physics sport played in a sunken valley. Drive the ball through the giant ring at your end to score, and every goal flips the court so you attack the other way. Matches last five minutes. There is no out of bounds, no whistles, and no auto-aim. Where you stand and when you swing decide every shot.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Valleyball Versus
0:14 How to score (and the flip)
0:32 The clock
0:42 The court is a bowl
0:52 No out of bounds
1:03 Run, sprint, jump
1:14 The Cut
1:24 Kick or volley
1:34 The spike
1:45 Timing: the sweet spot
1:55 Aim: nobody aims for you
2:06 The dive
2:16 The brace
2:27 Full contact
2:37 Three balls, three games
2:49 No whistles, just play
3:02 Modes
3:14 Put it all together

CONTROLS (gamepad / keyboard)
Move: Left stick / WASD
Sprint: LT / Shift
Jump: A / Space
Cut: RB / V
Volley or kick: B / E / Left click
Spike: Y / R / Right click
Dive: X / Q
Brace: LB / G
Slide: RT / C

MODES
1v1 against the AI (Easy, Medium, Hard), local 1v1 versus, and Practice with all three balls.

All footage is captured in-engine from the game's real physics, with no animation tricks.

Music: "Maximum Velocity" by Valleyball Studios

#ValleyballVersus #IndieGame #PhysicsGame
